overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Hybrid Ab Initio and Empirical Machine Learning Models for the Potential Energy Surface》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.17987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energetic materials involve multiple interactions, making reliable machine-learning potentials (MLPs) difficult to construct without extensive datasets. Here, we enhance the ability of the neural network interatomic potential (NNAP) to describe molecular systems using sphmulti, a refined spherical-harmonic basis set that combines extra radial basis with element-specific chemical weighting in each radial channel. We further integrate hyperactive learning, farthest-point sampling, and iterative sufficiency criteria with knowledge-guided key events, enabling the NNAP to retain essential information for describing the material system. For 3,3'-diamino-4,4'-azoxyfurazan, the resulting NNAP is trained on only 13,680 configurations yet captures key properties, including the isomerization barrier, pyrolysis activation energy, and shock Hugoniot behavior. NNAP-driven molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that pyrolysis proceeds through furazan-ring opening followed by chain reactions, whereas shock loading induces anisotropic hydrogen transfer driven by interlayer structural deformations. This work enables efficient and reliable MLPs for energetic materials.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：机器学习势与原子级动力学、主动学习和高通量采样、分子动力学与有限温度轨迹。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Benchmarking machine-learning interatomic potentials using classical force fields
full_list.title_zh: 使用经典力场对机器学习原子间势进行基准测试
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a rational comparison between several well-known machine-learning interatomic potentials (linear atomic cluster expansion, the Behler-Parrinello high-dimensional neural network potential, and the graph neural network-based MACE potential) by testing their performance for fitting classical potentials such as the Lennard-Jones and Stillinger-Weber potential. With this we assess their advantages and limitations regarding several aspects: varying training dataset size, robustness to noise, carbon footprint, as well as the ability to reproduce the radial distribution function as an example observable. Overall the MACE models are shown to most accurately reproduce the potential energy surface, with little sign of overfitting, but at a significant computational cost, highlighting important questions regarding the choice of models in computational materials science.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过测试几种著名的机器学习原子间势（线性原子团簇扩展、Behler-Parrinello 高维神经网络势和基于图神经网络的 MACE 势）对它们拟合经典势（如 Lennard-Jones 和 Stillinger-Weber 势）的性能进行理性比较。由此，我们评估了它们在几个方面的优点和局限性：不同的训练数据集大小、对噪声的鲁棒性、碳足迹，以及重现径向分布函数作为可观察示例的能力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过测试几种著名的机器学习原子间势（线性原子团簇扩展、Behler-Parrinello 高维神经网络势和基于图神经网络的 MACE 势）对它们拟合经典势（如 Lennard-Jones 和 Stillinger-Weber 势）的性能进行理性比较。由此，我们评估了它们在几个方面的优点和局限性：不同的训练数据集大小、对噪声的鲁棒性、碳足迹，以及重现径向分布函数作为可观察示例的能力。总体而言，MACE 模型能够最准确地再现势能面，几乎没有过度拟合的迹象，但计算成本很高，这凸显了计算材料科学中模型选择的重要问题。

full_list.title_en: Indirect prediction and screening of frustrated magnetic materials using machine learning
full_list.title_zh: 使用机器学习间接预测和筛选受阻磁性材料
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic frustration is commonly quantified by the frustration index, calculated from the Curie-Weiss and Neel temperatures. Because both quantities are not simultaneously available for most materials, direct prediction of the magnetic frustration index remains challenging. Here, we propose a machine learning workflow for indirect prediction of the frustration index and consequent screening of potential frustrated magnetic compounds through independent prediction of Curie-Weiss and Neel temperatures. In our work, composition-based models implemented via the CatBoost algorithm, trained on experimental data were optimized using chemically informed dataset subdivision. The highest predictive accuracy was achieved for the rare earth-oxide model in predicting Neel and for the rare earth model in predicting Curie-Weiss. Ensemble uncertainty was incorporated through a conservative frustration index to improve the reliability of candidate selection. Screening of approximately 67000 Materials Project compounds identified 20 high-confidence frustrated magnetic candidates, including several experimentally known frustrated magnets and previously unexplored oxide systems potential for further investigation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁挫败通常通过挫败指数来量化，挫败指数是根据居里-维斯和尼尔温度计算得出的。由于大多数材料无法同时获得这两个量，因此直接预测磁挫败指数仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种机器学习工作流程，用于间接预测挫败指数，并通过独立预测居里-维斯和尼尔温度来筛选潜在的挫败磁性化合物。在我们的工作中，通过 CatBoost 算法实现的基于成分的模型，在实验数据上进行训练，并使用化学信息数据集细分进行优化。稀土氧化物模型在尼尔预测中和稀土模型在居里-魏斯预测中获得了最高的预测精度。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用机器学习间接预测和筛选受阻磁性材料》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni₂MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
full_list.title_zh: 利用机器学习力场对 Ni2MnGa 中马氏体相变的动力学进行建模
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The martensitic transformations in stoichiometric Ni₂MnGa and related Heusler alloys are governed by a delicate interplay between electronic structure, magnetism, and lattice dynamics. While density functional theory (DFT) has successfully mapped the energy landscape of modulated martensites, it remains computationally prohibitive for capturing finite-temperature dynamics across relevant length and time scales. Here, we bridge this gap by constructing DFT-trained machine-learning force-fields (ML-FF) interpolated from ab initio molecular dynamics. We demonstrate that ML-FF trained on DFT data can reproduce key features of Ni₂MnGa, including the soft TA₂ phonon and a preference for nanotwinned martensites. Using classical molecular dynamics simulations, we explore the impact of adaptive nanotwinning on the austenite-martensite transition, which facilitates the dynamics of both, forward and backward transformation. We demonstrate, that the negative twin boundary energy along the entire transformations path predicted by DFT for T=0, supports the formation of ordered modulated martensites at finite temperatures. Our results pave the way for large-scale simulations of magnetic shape memory alloys with near-DFT accuracy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 化学计量 Ni2MnGa 和相关 Heusler 合金中的马氏体转变受到电子结构、磁性和晶格动力学之间微妙的相互作用的控制。虽然密度泛函理论（DFT）已经成功地绘制了调制马氏体的能量图，但它在计算上仍然无法捕获相关长度和时间尺度的有限温度动态。在这里，我们通过构建从头开始分子动力学插值的 DFT 训练的机器学习力场 (ML-FF) 来弥补这一差距。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 化学计量 Ni2MnGa 和相关 Heusler 合金中的马氏体转变受到电子结构、磁性和晶格动力学之间微妙的相互作用的控制。虽然密度泛函理论（DFT）已经成功地绘制了调制马氏体的能量图，但它在计算上仍然无法捕获相关长度和时间尺度的有限温度动态。在这里，我们通过构建从头开始分子动力学插值的 DFT 训练的机器学习力场 (ML-FF) 来弥补这一差距。我们证明，在 DFT 数据上训练的 ML-FF 可以重现 Ni2MnGa 的关键特征，包括软 TA2 声子和对纳米孪晶马氏体的偏好。使用经典的分子动力学模拟，我们探索了自适应纳米孪晶对奥氏体-马氏体转变的影响，这促进了向前和向后转变的动力学。我们证明，在 T=0 时，DFT 预测的整个转变路径上的负孪晶边界能支持在有限温度下形成有序调制马氏体。我们的结果为具有接近 DFT 精度的磁性形状记忆合金的大规模模拟铺平了道路。

full_list.title_en: Prediction of solvent aggregation in CO 2 -loaded aqueous amines using machine learning molecular dynamics simulations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Prediction of solvent aggregation in CO 2 -loaded aqueous amines using machine learning molecular dynamics simulations
full_list.abstract: Aggregation of ion pairs formed during CO 2 capture may govern absorption thermodynamics and kinetics, but it is often overestimated by fixed-charge classical force fields. Here, we demonstrate the promise of graph neural network interatomic potentials, which offer quantum-level accuracy, for directly evaluating the aggregation tendencies of ionic products in CO 2 -loaded aqueous amine solutions.

full_list.title_en: Large Out-of-plane Polarization in Two-dimensional Bi2O3 Monolayers Predicted by an AI-driven Inverse-design Workflow
full_list.title_zh: AI 驱动的逆向设计工作流程预测二维 Bi2O3 单层膜中的大面外偏振
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) polar oxides with built-in electric fields offer promising opportunities for nanoscale electronics, optoelectronics, and surface charge engineering. However, their discovery remains challenging due to the enormous structural complexity of nonlayered oxide networks. Here, we combine inverse structural design with a machine-learning interatomic potential and first-principles calculations to explore 2D oxide configurations. Using Bi2O3 as a representative system, we identify two previously unreported polar monolayers with tetragonal and orthorhombic symmetries. Both structures exhibit vertically separated Bi and O sublayers, giving rise to pronounced intrinsic polarity with Berry-phase 2D polarizations of 34.12 and 37.15 pC/m, respectively. Notably, the o-Bi2O3 monolayer exhibits one of the largest reported out-of-plane polarizations among 2D oxides. Both monolayers exhibit dynamical stability, finite-temperature structural integrity, and wide band gaps (~3.8 eV). The large polarization originates from dimensionality-induced reconstruction of the nonlayered Bi-O network, which breaks local coordination symmetry and produces out-of-plane charge redistribution, while the stereochemically active Bi 6s2 lone pair further favors asymmetric Bi-O bonding. These findings suggest dimensionality-induced local-coordination symmetry breaking as a promising design motif for high-polarization 2D oxides, and demonstrate the utility of combining inverse design with machine-learning-assisted screening to explore unconventional polar phases in nonlayered oxide networks.
full_list.abstract_zh: 具有内置电场的二维（2D）极性氧化物为纳米级电子学、光电子学和表面电荷工程提供了有前景的机会。然而，由于非层状氧化物网络结构的巨大复杂性，他们的发现仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将逆向结构设计与机器学习原子间势和第一原理计算相结合，以探索二维氧化物构型。使用 Bi2O3 作为代表性系统，我们识别出两种先前未报道的具有四方和斜方对称性的极性单层。两种结构都表现出垂直分离的 Bi 和 O 子层，产生明显的固有极性，贝里相 2D 极化分别为 34.12 和 37.15 pC/m。

full_list.title_en: Can Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials Capture Small Polarons? A Geometry-Based Benchmark in Transition-Metal Oxides
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Can Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials Capture Small Polarons? A Geometry-Based Benchmark in Transition-Metal Oxides
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.17352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small polarons, formed when excess electrons become localized through lattice distortions, play a critical role in charge transport, catalysis, and degradation processes in transition-metal (TM) oxides. Whether universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs), which lack explicit electronic degrees of freedom, can describe them remains unclear. Here, we investigate H-induced electron localization across a range of TM oxides using a geometric descriptor based on TM-O bond-length expansion (Z-score) to identify polaronic distortions. We find that uMLIPs exhibit varying degrees of electron localization, from delocalized states to metastable small polarons, with their behavior strongly dependent on the training data and treatment of electronic correlations. In particular, the absence of Hubbard U corrections for specific TM cations in the training data leads to electron delocalization, in contrast to DFT+U predictions. Although some uMLIPs reproduce polaron hopping barriers during coupled proton-polaron transfer, all of them fail to stabilize spatially separated polaron-donor configurations, instead favoring localization near the H dopant.

full_list.title_en: Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta βₑ₀=0.2, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. With density fully hidden, just 0.1% magnetic spatial visibility reduces median density NRMSE from approximately 0.9 to 0.1. Conversely, observed density improves current-density reconstruction when magnetic data are absent or extremely sparse. With no magnetic observations, roughly 1% density visibility approaches the density reconstruction accuracy achieved with fully observed magnetic fields, although current structure remains more dependent on direct magnetic measurements. Full magnetic conditioning also stabilizes completion of missing future density frames. These results demonstrate bidirectional cross-modal predictive coupling within this simulation regime. Generalization across plasma regimes or to experimental measurements remains untested.

full_list.title_en: Solvating machine-learning interatomic potentials for solution-phase chemistry
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Solvating machine-learning interatomic potentials for solution-phase chemistry
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.17226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are trained on gas-phase data, which limits their use for chemistry in solution. Here, we introduce AnySolv, a transferable implicit solvation potential that provides solvent-dependent energy and force corrections to existing gas-phase potentials without retraining them. It is trained on 1.4 million solvation energies and forces computed with density functional theory (DFT) and SMD in 36 solvents, spanning charged, open-shell, and transition-state structures. Because solvents are represented by continuous physical descriptors, AnySolv supports 179 solvents, including those absent from training. On external benchmarks, AnySolv reproduces DFT-SMD solvation energies to 2-4 meV mean absolute error at more than three orders of magnitude lower cost, and it matches the accuracy of DFT-SMD against experimental solvation free energies. This enables screening of the mechanisms of 120 nucleophilic aromatic substitution reactions in six phases as well as molecular dynamics simulations that reproduce the experimentally observed solvent-dependent conformational preferences of alanine dipeptide. By providing transferable solvation corrections to existing MLIPs, AnySolv enables scalable simulations of solvent-dependent chemical reactivity and molecular dynamics.

full_list.title_en: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep neural networks that predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonians from material structures offer a route to efficient electronic-structure calculations. However, extending localized atomic-orbital (AO) Hamiltonian learning to plane-wave (PW) calculations with hybrid functionals requires a compact AO representation that preserves the effects of nonlocal operators. Here we propose a projectability-guided construction of nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians from a small, selected set of PW eigenstates and eigenvalues. High-projectability states are retained, and selected higher-energy states complete the AO subspace, avoiding an empirical shift and its arbitrary contribution to the learning targets. Because the construction uses PW eigenstates and eigenvalues, it incorporates nonlocal contributions present in the reference calculation without explicitly reconstructing their AO matrix elements. Benchmarks for MoS2 and sodium phases show accurate reproduction of PW bands with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction. The resulting PBE and HSE Hamiltonians can be learned by equivariant neural networks, connecting PW reference calculations with electronic-structure prediction. This approach broadens the range of PW DFT calculations available for AO Hamiltonian learning and enables compact, accurate training targets for developing more widely applicable electronic-structure models.

full_list.title_en: Material and thermal properties of MgCl 2 molten salt by ab initio and machine-learning molecular-dynamics simulations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Material and thermal properties of MgCl 2 molten salt by ab initio and machine-learning molecular-dynamics simulations
full_list.abstract: We study the structural, thermophysical, and dynamical properties of molten MgCl 2 over a wide temperature range using Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics (AIMD) and molecular dynamics simulations based on machine-learning interaction potentials (MLIPs). MLIPs can achieve near-AIMD accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost, enabling simulations of larger systems and longer timescales. This opens up the possibility of studying the system under out-of-equilibrium conditions, which in turn allows for the calculation of physical properties, such as the thermal conductivity or viscosity, that cannot be obtained reliably for the typical time and length scales accessible to AIMD. We follow two complementary approaches to develop and evaluate the MLIPs. First, we develop a Deep Potential (DP) from scratch using AIMD trajectories at different temperatures. Second, we also evaluate two out-of-the-box foundation models and a fine-tuned version of one of them. The fine-tuning is performed using configurations from the AIMD trajectories originally used to train the DP. We compare the predictions of the trained DP, the foundation models, and AIMD simulations with the available experimental data and provide a comprehensive calculation of the most important physical quantities of molten MgCl 2 . We compute densities, radial and angular distribution functions, thermal conductivity, heat capacity, viscosity, and diffusion coefficients over the 1000–1600 K temperature range. This range is relevant to important technological applications such as thermal energy storage, generation IV nuclear reactors, and concentrated solar power systems. Finally, we briefly review the accuracy and performance of the different MLIP versions used throughout the work.

full_list.title_en: Extrapolating Collisional Rate Coefficients for Molecules of Astrophysical Interest Using Neural Networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Extrapolating Collisional Rate Coefficients for Molecules of Astrophysical Interest Using Neural Networks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State-to-state rate coefficients for inelastic molecular collisions are essential inputs for non-local thermodynamic equilibrium radiative transfer models, yet their computation using quantum scattering methods is prohibitive for large molecules and highly excited rotational states. We investigate the ability of artificial neural networks to extend existing datasets of collisional excitation rate coefficients without performing additional scattering calculations. A multilayer perceptron model was trained using molecular quantum numbers, level energies, energy gaps, and kinetic temperature as descriptors, and optimized on logarithmic rate coefficients. The model was tested on diverse collision systems ranging from simple diatomic molecules (CO, SiO) to open-shell species (SO), small asymmetric tops (H₂O, SO₂), and complex organic molecules (benzonitrile and vinyl cyanide) colliding with H₂ molecules or He atoms. Extrapolations were performed toward higher rotational levels, higher temperatures, and combinations of both. For most systems, predictions of rate coefficients involving previously unseen rotational states yielded mean error factors between 1.1 and 1.5, with the dominant rate coefficients generally reproduced more accurately than weaker transitions. Temperature extrapolations proved particularly successful, while combined extrapolations in temperature and rotational levels remained accurate to within a factor of two in most cases. The prediction quality depends on the interplay between dataset size, temperature range, molecular complexity, and the presence of clear collisional propensity rules. Overall, the approach demonstrates that machine learning can provide a practical route to extending collisional datasets for astrophysical applications, especially for large molecules for which additional quantum-scattering calculations are computationally demanding.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Transfer learning-aided, artificial intelligence approach to evaluate optical properties of materials for classical and quantum photonic applications
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, an artificial intelligence-assisted evaluation of the refractive indices of different materials is performed. The evaluation of the refractive index is necessary to design photonic devices for various classical and quantum photonic applications, and to theoretically analyse experimental results. The refractive index is one of the crucial parameters that affect the interaction of light with matter. Although the refractive index can be measured experimentally, its estimation via computational means provide the advantage of not requiring costly instrumentation, trained researchers and could avoid potential laboratory-based uncertainties. Therefore, in this study, artificial intelligence is implemented to estimate the optical constants of two types of materials, i.e., noble metals, and semiconductors. To this end, an artificial neural network is used to estimate the real and the imaginary parts of the refractive index of a specific material for various wavelengths of light. Then, the knowledge of the trained neural network is employed to initiate and train new neural networks to estimate the refractive indices of other materials. For the training of a neural network, various methods can be deployed. However, the application of the training can be a time-consuming process. A transfer learning approach is here implemented to provide a faster training solution for the problem under study. The implementation of transfer learning allows training the neural networks for a new material with higher speed or accuracy when compared to non-knowledge transfer-based training. Our results show the efficiency of the proposed technique in accurately evaluating the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index of different materials.

full_list.title_en: Two-atom interaction potential database supporting physics-informed features for machine learning and material property prediction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Two-atom interaction potential database supporting physics-informed features for machine learning and material property prediction
full_list.abstract: Accurately predicting the energy and relevant properties of molecules and complex crystalline systems remains a cornerstone of computational materials science. While density functional theory (DFT) offers high accuracy, its computational cost scales prohibitively for large-scale materials. In this work, we present a comprehensive, first-principles-derived database of two-atom interaction potentials and interatomic forces to accelerate the property prediction via physics-informed machine learning. Computed using spin-polarized DFT via the GPAW package, the database encompasses all 2346 possible atomic pairs generated from 68 unique elements as a function of interatomic distance. The practical utility of this database was demonstrated within the many-body expansion framework by engineering highly descriptive features to predict three distinct types of energy for benchmarking. First, the framework was applied to predict the total energy of molecules within the G2/97 database. Second, for defect energetics on 2D materials (the IMP2D database), localized concentric shell potentials and spatial gradients were introduced to capture the formation energy of adsorbate defects. Finally, for molecular energetics within the QM9 database, we developed advanced descriptors, including a potential-based matrix, a two-body Bag of Bonds, and a three-body Ray’s asymmetric parameter histogram to evaluate atomization energy. Evaluated using kernel ridge regression, the combined two-body and three-body feature set yielded an outstanding test result with the mean absolute error of 0.186 eV ( R 2 = 0.9994) on a 10 000-samples subset. This framework showcases the power of utilizing explicit, database-derived potentials as robust descriptors for high-fidelity predictions of energy and relevant properties.

full_list.title_en: PolyFKAN: Integrating Fourier-KAN layers into graph neural networks for polymer property prediction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：PolyFKAN: Integrating Fourier-KAN layers into graph neural networks for polymer property prediction
full_list.abstract: Graph neural networks have become a central tool for polymer property prediction, but their fixed activation functions can impose a low-pass spectral bias that smooths over the sharp, multi-scale structure–property variations that distinguish chemically similar polymers. We address this limitation with PolyFKAN, a multitask graph-learning architecture that augments the prediction head of a polyGNN backbone with Fourier Kolmogorov–Arnold network layers. PolyFKAN represents edge-wise activations as truncated Fourier series and couples the resulting spectral branch to the standard multilayer perceptron (MLP) pathway through a bounded residual gate, thereby increasing functional expressivity without disrupting the learned graph embeddings. Across 17 polymer properties spanning electronic, thermodynamic, optical/dielectric, thermal, and gas-permeability domains, PolyFKAN achieves statistically significant improvement over a tightly controlled polyGNN baseline on 11 of 17 targets (one-sided t -test, p < 0.05), with one additional target showing marginal improvement. The gains are especially pronounced for multi-scale properties, including more than 15% average root mean squared error reduction for large-penetrant gas permeabilities and more than 15% improvement across optical and dielectric targets. Hierarchical ablation further reveals that optimal Fourier bandwidth is property-dependent: difficult, multi-scale targets require broader spectral capacity with stronger amplitude control, whereas high-fidelity targets benefit from lighter regularization. These results establish Fourier-KAN prediction heads as a minimally invasive and physically aligned inductive bias for polymer informatics.

full_list.title_en: Wisevolve Potential Engine: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics at 100 Million Atom-Steps per Second on a Single GPU
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Wisevolve Potential Engine: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics at 100 Million Atom-Steps per Second on a Single GPU
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.17366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: General-purpose molecular dynamics software supports diverse interatomic potentials and simulation requirements. Within a simulation stage, the loaded potential model and the required calculations typically remain fixed as the atomic configuration evolves. We present the Wisevolve Potential Engine (WPE), which uses this information from GPUMD to select and reuse a GPU execution policy tailored to the model and simulation stage. GPUMD retains simulation control and ownership of the simulation data. On a single NVIDIA RTX 5090, WPE-enabled GPUMD (GPUMD-WPE) achieves a median throughput of 109 million atom-step/s across 106 neuroevolution potential (NEP) workloads. For a 15.1-million-atom diamond Si system, it sustains 142 million atom-step/s. Relative to GPUMD, geometric-mean speedups are 3.49x across these NEP workloads, 3.61x across 16 workloads using NEP with dynamic charges (qNEP), 1.24x across 28 classical-potential workloads, and 10.5x across 56 path-integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) configurations. End-to-end calculations of water structure, lattice thermal conductivity, and PIMD thermal expansion show close agreement with corresponding GPUMD results and published simulation results. A separate 12.5-million-atom Cu shock-compression simulation demonstrates its applicability to large-scale nonequilibrium dynamics. These results support model- and stage-specific specialization as a practical way to accelerate GPU potential evaluation in general-purpose molecular dynamics workflows.

full_list.title_en: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% compared to a physics-only baseline, and outperforming a purely data-driven model. Results further show that incorporating system-level physics provides the largest performance gains, while additional refinements offer only marginal improvements. Beyond accuracy, the model improves robustness by constraining predictions toward physical feasibility, reducing unrealistic predictions under corrupted measurements.

full_list.title_en: Trust-Limited Machine-Learning-Accelerated Nudged Elastic Band Calculations for Small-Polaron Hopping in Rutile TiO2
full_list.title_zh: 金红石 TiO2 中小极化子跳跃的信任有限机器学习加速微移弹性带计算
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nudged elastic band (NEB) calculations of small-polaron hopping are demanding because nuclear motion is coupled to a self-consistent localized electronic state. Near the charge-transfer region, slow self-consistent-field convergence, localization switching, and competing electronic solutions complicate surrogate-assisted optimization. We develop a Gaussian-process-assisted NEB workflow for this regime and demonstrate electron small-polaron hopping in rutile TiO2 using spin-polarized density functional theory with a Hubbard U correction (DFT+U ) with SIESTA. A joint energy-force Gaussian process (GP) with a Matérn covariance model advances the elastic band, while active-atom root-mean-square and maximum-atom displacement limits constrain surrogate motion relative to evaluated configurations. Reaching these limits triggers first-principles sampling without requiring full surrogate convergence. Three independently DFT-verified 96-atom [001] calculations using 11, 13, and 15 images and different surrogate settings and GP parameterizations yield barriers of 0.1645, 0.1637, and 0.1640 eV, respectively, spanning 0.793 meV. In the 15-image calculation, repeated central-image sampling activates a separately calibrated local GP during surrogate optimization. Final full-band DFT verification gives a maximum projected NEB force of 0.0346 eV/Å. A 324-atom calculation yields a lower barrier of 0.1302 eV, indicating supercell sensitivity and demonstrating feasibility at larger GP observation dimension. The workflow combines controlled surrogate extrapolation, targeted charge-transfer-region interpolation, and independent DFT verification to obtain polaron migration pathways, emphasizing reproducible barriers and full-band force convergence.
full_list.abstract_zh: 小极化子跳跃的微移弹性带 (NEB) 计算要求很高，因为核运动与自洽的局域电子态耦合。在电荷转移区域附近，缓慢的自洽场收敛、局域化切换和竞争性电子解决方案使替代辅助优化变得复杂。我们为此方案开发了高斯过程辅助 NEB 工作流程，并使用自旋极化密度泛函理论以及 SIESTA 的 Hubbard U 校正 (DFT+U ) 演示了金红石 TiO2 中的电子小极化子跳跃。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 小极化子跳跃的微移弹性带 (NEB) 计算要求很高，因为核运动与自洽的局域电子态耦合。在电荷转移区域附近，缓慢的自洽场收敛、局域化切换和竞争性电子解决方案使替代辅助优化变得复杂。我们为此方案开发了高斯过程辅助 NEB 工作流程，并使用自旋极化密度泛函理论以及 SIESTA 的 Hubbard U 校正 (DFT+U ) 演示了金红石 TiO2 中的电子小极化子跳跃。联合能量-力高斯过程 (GP) 与 Matérn 协方差模型推进了弹性带，而活性原子均方根和最大原子位移限制则约束相对于评估配置的替代运动。达到这些限制会触发第一原理采样，而不需要完全代理收敛。使用 11、13 和 15 个图像以及不同的替代设置和 GP 参数化进行的三个独立 DFT 验证的 96 原子 [001] 计算分别产生 0.1645、0.1637 和 0.1640 eV 的势垒，跨越 0.793 meV。在 15 个图像计算中，重复的中心图像采样会在代理优化期间激活单独校准的局部 GP。最终的全频带 DFT 验证得出最大预计 NEB 力为 0.0346 eV/Å。 324 个原子的计算产生了 0.1302 eV 的较低势垒，表明了超胞敏感性并证明了在更大 GP 观察维度下的可行性。该工作流程结合了受控代理外推、目标电荷转移区域插值和独立的 DFT 验证，以获得极化子迁移路径，强调可重复的障碍和全带力收敛。

full_list.title_en: Theoretical Investigation of Oxygen-Vacancy Diffusion in SrTiO₃ using Neural Network Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 使用神经网络势理论研究 SrTiO₃ 中的氧空位扩散
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Oxygen-vacancy formation and diffusion play important roles in determining the electronic and atomic transport properties of SrTiO₃ (STO). Accurate analysis of such point defects requires sufficiently large-scale and long-time molecular dynamics (MD) simulations; however, direct investigations of oxygen-vacancy dynamics using it ab initio MD (AIMD) based on density functional theory (DFT) are limited to relatively small systems and short time scales because of their high computational cost. In this study, we develop a neural network potential (NNP) for pristine and oxygen-deficient STO using a reference dataset generated from AIMD simulations. The trained NNP model accurately reproduces the DFT reference energies, atomic forces, and virials for both pristine STO and STO containing an oxygen vacancy. The NNP also reproduces the supercell-size dependence of the total energies and oxygen-vacancy formation energies, including the formation energy extrapolated to the dilute limit. Large-scale and long-time MD simulations using the NNP (NNP-MD) are then performed to investigate oxygen-vacancy diffusion. The resulting oxygen-vacancy diffusion coefficients show substantially better agreement with experimental data than those obtained from conventional classical MD simulations. An Arrhenius analysis yields an oxygen-vacancy migration enthalpy of 0.64 eV, in close agreement with the experimental value of 0.67 eV. These results demonstrate that NNPs trained on first-principles data provide an accurate and computationally efficient framework for investigating defect formation and long-time vacancy transport in perovskite oxides.
full_list.abstract_zh: 氧空位的形成和扩散在决定 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的电子和原子传输特性方面发挥着重要作用。对此类点缺陷的精确分析需要足够大规模和长时间的分子动力学（MD）模拟；然而，由于计算成本较高，使用基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头MD (AIMD) 直接研究氧空位动力学仅限于相对较小的系统和较短的时间尺度。在这项研究中，我们使用 AIMD 模拟生成的参考数据集开发了用于原始缺氧 STO 的神经网络潜力 (NNP)。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 氧空位的形成和扩散在决定 SrTiO₃ (STO) 的电子和原子传输特性方面发挥着重要作用。对此类点缺陷的精确分析需要足够大规模和长时间的分子动力学（MD）模拟；然而，由于计算成本较高，使用基于密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的从头MD (AIMD) 直接研究氧空位动力学仅限于相对较小的系统和较短的时间尺度。在这项研究中，我们使用 AIMD 模拟生成的参考数据集开发了用于原始缺氧 STO 的神经网络潜力 (NNP)。经过训练的 NNP 模型准确地再现了原始 STO 和包含氧空位的 STO 的 DFT 参考能量、原子力和维里尔。 NNP 还再现了总能量和氧空位形成能的超晶胞尺寸依赖性，包括外推到稀极限的形成能。然后使用 NNP (NNP-MD) 进行大规模和长时间的 MD 模拟，以研究氧空位扩散。与传统经典 MD 模拟获得的氧空位扩散系数相比，所得氧空位扩散系数与实验数据的吻合程度要好得多。阿伦尼乌斯分析得出氧空位迁移焓为 0.64 eV，与实验值 0.67 eV 非常一致。这些结果表明，基于第一原理数据训练的 NNP 为研究钙钛矿氧化物中的缺陷形成和长期空位传输提供了准确且计算高效的框架。

full_list.title_en: Pressure-transferable universal machine-learning potentials: the WBM-MatPES benchmark and Tuga-FF
full_list.title_zh: 可压力转移的通用机器学习潜力：WBM-MatPES 基准和 Tuga-FF
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials hold the promise to replace costly ab initio calculations in materials science workflows. However, the accuracy and transferability of current models are limited by the availability of training data. We release WBM-MatPES, a dataset of 182 thousand structures recomputed with consistent MatPES settings, together with two reference convex hulls of different depths and test sets at six pressures up to 150 GPa. These datasets reproduce a realistic discovery workflow and allow potentials to be ranked systematically at this level of theory, similar to the Matbench Discovery leaderboard at the Materials Project settings. In this benchmark, five published MatPES potentials agree within 12 meV/atom at 25 GPa, yet their errors increase dramatically to 0.4-5 eV/atom at 150 GPa. To address this limitation, we develop Tuga-FF, a graph transformer trained on datasets spanning ambient and high-pressure configurations alike. Tuga-FF is the most accurate model in the benchmark at ambient pressure, with an energy error of 13.6 meV/atom, and maintains an error of just 21 meV/atom at 150 GPa. We believe this benchmark will encourage the community to train higher-accuracy models and generate richer datasets, advancing machine-learned interatomic potentials as a whole.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通用机器学习原子间势有望取代材料科学工作流程中昂贵的从头计算。然而，当前模型的准确性和可转移性受到训练数据可用性的限制。我们发布了 WBM-MatPES，这是一个使用一致的 MatPES 设置重新计算的 182,000 个结构的数据集，以及两个不同深度的参考凸包和在高达 150 GPa 的六种压力下的测试集。这些数据集再现了现实的发现工作流程，并允许在这一理论水平上系统地对潜力进行排名，类似于材料项目设置中的 Matbench 发现排行榜。

full_list.title_en: On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by learning the energies and forces that govern atomic motion. Recent work has shown that relaxing physical inductive biases can improve computational efficiency and predictive accuracy, raising the question of whether energy-and-force matching alone is sufficient to ensure accurate sampling. We show that, for unconstrained hypothesis classes, the relationship between prediction error and sampling accuracy is exponentially ill-conditioned in dimension. In particular, prediction errors that decay exponentially with dimension can coexist with nearly maximal total variation distance between the learned and target distributions. We identify two failure mechanisms. The first is kinetic trapping, where relaxation to an accurate learned equilibrium requires exponentially long times, even when simulations are initialized from training configurations at which energies and forces are matched exactly. The second is equilibrium mismatch, where the learned stationary distribution itself remains far from the target. Under explicit assumptions, we show that equilibrium mismatch can persist even in local, symmetry-preserving models, where small per-atom errors coexist with a distributional discrepancy that approaches its maximum as system size increases. Finally, we establish global energy-control conditions that guarantee equilibrium accuracy and identify additional conditions required for rapid relaxation.

full_list.title_en: Learning Electron Density with Virtual Atoms for Transferable Atomistic Representations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Learning Electron Density with Virtual Atoms for Transferable Atomistic Representations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron density is a fundamental quantity of electronic structure, yet most machine learning density models treat it solely as a reconstruction target and are developed separately from machine learning interatomic potentials. Here, we introduce a virtual-atom formulation within the DPA3 framework, in which density query points are represented as virtual nodes and processed by the same parameterized encoder used for real atoms. An asymmetric neighbor construction allows virtual atoms to receive information from nearby real atoms without altering the real-atom interaction graph. The resulting framework supports density, energy, and force prediction through task-specific readout heads. The proposed model achieves state-of-the-art density reconstruction accuracy on the Materials Project benchmark, matches the best reported performance on nickel-manganese-cobalt battery cathode materials, and is competitive with dedicated density models on QM9. When density labels are used jointly with energy and force supervision, the model improves in-domain accuracy, makes local environment information more accessible under linear probing, and reduces zero-shot force errors on larger QM40 molecules. Density-only checkpoints also provide useful initializations for downstream energy-force learning under the fixed fine-tuning protocol. Together, these results support electron density as a source of electronic-structure supervision for interatomic-potential representations.

full_list.title_en: DiffGA: Steering Frozen Diffusion Models for Materials Design via Evolutionary Search
full_list.title_zh: DiffGA：通过进化搜索引导材料设计的冻结扩散模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Steering candidate generation toward user-defined objectives is central to inverse materials design, yet remains difficult when objectives are black-box, changing, or non-differentiable, as in many simulation- and experiment-derived properties. Generative models offer a solution but typically require retraining or fine-tuning for each new objective, demanding labeled data and substantial compute, or rely on differentiable guidance that is brittle to gradient noise and undefined for many practical targets. We present DiffGA, a retraining-free framework that injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory of a retrained diffusion model, evolving partially denoised states under an arbitrary black-box oracle. Because oracle evaluation often dominates campaign cost, we couple DiffGA with an on-the-fly Bayesian surrogate that reuses representations from state-of-the-art machine-learned force fields (MLFFs). A Gaussian process is fit during the campaign on the force fields's graph embeddings and, once it demonstrably ranks an unseen generation, replaces expensive property evaluations under an uncertainty-aware acquisition rule, reducing oracle cost with negligible loss of accuracy. Across three crystal-design tasks using a frozen MatterGen backbone, DiffGA outperforms diffusion-only, compute-matched, purely evolutionary, and fine-tuned baselines in oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits. Rather than proposing scientific compounds, we use density functional theory to quantify MLFF oracle fidelity, showing that it is a faithful proxy in key regimes but systematically biased in others, delineating when proxy-driven generative discovery can be trusted. On a representative sample, DiffGA's top hits survive first principles re-evaluation as physically realistic hits, while the surrogate-accelerated pipeline preserves this fidelity at a fraction of the cost.
full_list.abstract_zh: 引导候选生成朝着用户定义的目标是逆向材料设计的核心，但当目标是黑盒的、变化的或不可微的时，就像在许多模拟和实验衍生的属性中一样，仍然很困难。生成模型提供了一种解决方案，但通常需要对每个新目标进行重新训练或微调，需要标记数据和大量计算，或者依赖于梯度噪声脆弱且对于许多实际目标未定义的可微指导。我们提出了 DiffGA，这是一种无需再训练的框架，它将进化搜索注入到再训练扩散模型的采样轨迹中，在任意黑盒预言下演化出部分去噪状态。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 引导候选生成朝着用户定义的目标是逆向材料设计的核心，但当目标是黑盒的、变化的或不可微的时，就像在许多模拟和实验衍生的属性中一样，仍然很困难。生成模型提供了一种解决方案，但通常需要对每个新目标进行重新训练或微调，需要标记数据和大量计算，或者依赖于梯度噪声脆弱且对于许多实际目标未定义的可微指导。我们提出了 DiffGA，这是一种无需再训练的框架，它将进化搜索注入到再训练扩散模型的采样轨迹中，在任意黑盒预言下演化出部分去噪状态。由于预言机评估通常主导活动成本，因此我们将 DiffGA 与动态贝叶斯代理结合起来，该代理重用来自最先进的机器学习力场 (MLFF) 的表示。高斯过程适合在力场的图嵌入上进行运动，一旦它对看不见的一代进行了明显的排名，就可以在不确定性感知的获取规则下取代昂贵的属性评估，从而降低预言机成本，而准确性损失可以忽略不计。在使用冻结的 MatterGen 主干的三个晶体设计任务中，DiffGA 在预言机评估的稳定、独特和新颖命中率方面优于仅扩散、计算匹配、纯进化和微调基线。我们没有提出科学化合物，而是使用密度泛函理论来量化 MLFF 预言机的保真度，表明它是关键机制中的忠实代理，但在其他机制中存在系统性偏见，从而描述了何时可以信任代理驱动的生成发现。在代表性样本中，DiffGA 的热门命中经受了第一原理重新评估，成为物理上真实的命中，而代理加速管道以一小部分成本保留了这种保真度。

full_list.title_en: Transition-Metal Chalcogenide Nanowires: A First-Principles Study of Stability, Electronic Structure, and Mechanical Response
full_list.title_zh: 过渡金属硫族化物纳米线：稳定性、电子结构和机械响应的第一性原理研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subnanometer transition-metal chalcogenide nanowires provide a one-dimensional platform in which electronic functionality and mechanical response can be tuned through chemical composition. Here, density functional theory calculations are combined with machine-learning force-field (MLFF) molecular dynamics to investigate MoS, MoSe, MoTe, WS, WSe, and WTe nanowires. The optimized structures are dynamically stable within the harmonic approximation, and their electronic character evolves systematically across the chalcogen series: MoS, MoSe, WS, and WSe are metallic, whereas MoTe and WTe are semiconducting, with HSE06 band gaps of 0.52 and 0.20 eV, respectively. The effective axial stiffness decreases from sulfides to selenides and tellurides, consistent with the increase in metal--chalcogen bond length; using a circular effective cross section, the corresponding Young moduli range from 392 to 718 GPa. All six nanowires have negative formation energies relative to the selected elemental reference phases. MLFF trajectories extending to 2.5 ns at 300 K preserve the one-dimensional morphology and local atomic order, providing evidence of finite-temperature dynamical stability on the simulated time scale. The corresponding MLFF molecular-dynamics energy traces are shown in. We further examine the response of the nanowires to axial strain and curvature, including strain-induced band-gap modulation in the tellurides. These results establish composition and mechanical deformation as complementary routes for tuning the electronic and mechanical properties of ultrathin transition-metal chalcogenide nanowires and support their further investigation as components of flexible nanoelectronic systems.

full_list.title_en: Blending experimental electron density information to protein-ligand interaction
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Blending experimental electron density information to protein-ligand interaction
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning models for protein-ligand interactions commonly rely on atomic coordinates, which are constructed by fitting molecular models to experimental electron-density maps. However, most models represent each complex as a single fitted structure, which can omit information about conformational heterogeneity, positional uncertainty, and local density support for individual atoms at binding interfaces. To fill this gap, we present CoDE, a Coordinate and Density Encoder, pre-trained on experimental density maps. We represent each binding site on a shared three-dimensional voxel grid combining atomic occupancy, experimental electron density, and its gradient magnitude. Using approximately 100K curated complexes, we pre-train a channel-wise vision transformer to jointly reconstruct masked atomic and density channels, learning a representation that integrates structural and experimental information. We evaluate the frozen encoder on two downstream tasks: (i) binding-affinity regression under leakage-controlled splits and (ii) pocket-conditioned ligand generation. Across these settings, CoDE improves over an identically pre-trained coordinate-only encoder and remains competitive with task-specific baselines, showing that density complements fitted atomic coordinates for protein-ligand interaction modeling and that the density-blended representation is useful for structure-based ligand generation.

full_list.title_en: High-throughput screening of Heusler alloys for thermoelectrics combining machine-learned densities of states and first-principles transport
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：High-throughput screening of Heusler alloys for thermoelectrics combining machine-learned densities of states and first-principles transport
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermoelectrics turn waste heat into electricity, but finding new ones requires transport calculations too costly for whole databases. Searches therefore choose what to calculate from the electronic density of states (DOS), increasingly predicted by machine learning, yet such choices are rarely tested. We test them on all 106,235 Heusler structures in the DXMag database, screening 51,257 on density-functional spectra and 54,978 on neural-network predictions, and judging both by 3,625 band-structure and transport calculations. A DOS-derived Seebeck indicator ranks most compounds passing every transport and stability test within the top 1% of their population, and ten of the eleven established half-Heusler thermoelectrics calculated pass. Predicted spectra lose most band gaps, unnoticed by spectral-similarity metrics, yet still rank passing compounds near the top. The screen certifies 80 computational candidates, 61 without reported measurements. Computed or predicted, the DOS can choose what to calculate; only a band structure shows whether a gap exists.

full_list.title_en: Role of defect trapping in the enhanced corrosion resistance of Ni-Mo alloys with yttrium and yttrium oxide additions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Role of defect trapping in the enhanced corrosion resistance of Ni-Mo alloys with yttrium and yttrium oxide additions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Corrosion of structural alloys remains a critical challenge for advanced molten salt reactors, where aggressive fluoride salts promote continuous dissolution at the salt-metal interface. While most mitigation strategies emphasize thermodynamic stability, kinetic control of atomic transport has received comparatively less attention. Here, we propose a corrosion mitigation strategy based on diffusion control and vacancy trapping by dilute yttrium (Y) solutes and yttrium oxide (Y₂O₃) dispersions in Ni alloys. A combined computational and experimental approach integrates density functional theory (DFT), self-consistent mean-field (SCMF) diffusion modeling, and an impurity trapping model to quantify the impact of defect trapping on effective vacancy mobility. Strong first-nearest-neighbor vacancy-Y binding, off-lattice vacancy configurations, and elevated rotational and dissociation barriers result in pronounced suppression of vacancy diffusivity, while Y₂O₃-associated sites treated as fixed traps in the model further reduce the mobile vacancy population. Ni-Mo (NM), Y-modified (NMY), and Y₂O₃-containing (NMYO) alloys were tested in molten fluoride salt at 750degC. Corrosion penetration decreases systematically from NM to NMY to NMYO, consistent with the predicted reduction in vacancy-mediated transport. The same trend is observed in mass change, with net weight loss decreasing from 0.52% for NM to 0.23% for NMY and 0.09% for NMYO. These results are consistent with an alloy-side transport contribution from defect trapping and reduced atomic transport. This study therefore suggests point defect engineering as a promising alloy design strategy for extreme nuclear environments.

full_list.title_en: Atoms that Matter: Largest Materials Datasets Are 99% Redundant, and Local Chemistry Can Guide the Required 1%

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: General-purpose machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) for materials are now trained on the order of 100 million structures, assuming transferability requires such scale. We test this premise on OMat24, the largest available materials dataset, by training MACE models on subsets of 6.5 million atoms, less than 1% of OMat24, selected in three complementary ways: at random, by latent-space clustering of a pretrained MLFF (DIRECT), and by a new model-free method maximizing the diversity of discrete, interpretable local environments (EnvTok). All three models approach the full-data reference MACE-OMAT-0 model to within a few tens of meV/mathringA in forces, and remain close to or exceed it on formation energies, elastic moduli, heat capacities, Li⁺ migration barriers, and molecular-dynamics stability up to 3000,K and 500,GPa. This near-independence from the selection strategy shows that chemical environment diversity, not size, defines OMat24's information content: the remaining 99% of structures are largely redundant. Broad sampling of chemical space thus remains essential, but reference labels are needed only for structurally and chemically distinct configurations. Using atomic positions and species, optionally augmented by magnetic moments, EnvTok identifies these before any labelling or training, yielding compact, architecture-independent datasets. This hundredfold reduction makes hybrid-DFT or higher-level relabelling of general-purpose training sets feasible, and frees computational budget for extending environmental coverage and multi-fidelity learning.

full_list.title_en: Machine-learned topological transport of magnetic colloids
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine-learned topological transport of magnetic colloids
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.17344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By modulating the orientation of a uniform magnetic field it is possible to transport magnetic microparticles above magnetic patterns. In periodic patterns, driving control loops that wind around special orientations, which are dictated by the symmetry of the pattern, induce transport by one unit cell. The transport is topologically protected with trajectories controlled by the winding numbers of the control loop around the special orientations. In non-periodic patterns, the special orientations are position dependent, precluding a global characterization of the transport using a small set of winding numbers. We use here a reinforcement learning agent trained with Brownian dynamics simulation data that uses the local environment of the magnetic pattern to decide an action over the control loop. The agent autonomously discovers topological transport protocols directly from the particle response without prior characterization of the magnetic potential landscape. An agent trained solely on a complex non-periodic pattern directly generalizes to completely unseen periodic, quasicrystalline, and disordered substrates. Moreover, the agent dynamically adjusts the control loop to transport particles across lattice defects and to counterbalance external drift forces that would cause static topological loops to fail. By adding a pathfinding algorithm to the model, we additionally achieve simultaneous, independent transport of multiple identical colloids along different on demand trajectories. We demonstrate that the control loops can be directly transferred to an experimental setup to successfully drive magnetic microparticles across a non-uniform magnetic thin film.

full_list.title_en: Joint Neural Posterior Estimation and Model Selection for Chemical Reaction Networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Joint Neural Posterior Estimation and Model Selection for Chemical Reaction Networks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulation-based Bayesian inference for Chemical Reaction Networks (CRNs) must simultaneously solve two computationally demanding problems: discriminating between overlapping reaction pathways and estimating reaction rate constants. Classical approaches, such as Sequential Monte Carlo ABC, rely on handcrafted summary statistics and scale poorly across large parameter spaces. To overcome this, we introduce a neural inference architecture. Our pipeline utilizes shared 1D-CNNs and a permutation-invariant Set Attention mechanism to learn low-dimensional summary statistics from variable-length, multi-experiment time-series data. These statistics simultaneously condition a model selection network to compute posterior model probabilities and model-specific conditional Invertible Neural Networks (cINNs) that estimate parameter posterior distributions. We demonstrate the practical utility of our approach on a real protodeboronation example, illustrating how it handles structural ambiguity and extracts kinetic parameters from competing catalyst deactivation pathways.

full_list.title_en: Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cross-material magnetic core loss prediction requires adapting to new material responses with limited measurements. Global feature alignment overlooks differences in source and target excitation coverage. This motivates selecting comparable samples and controlling each source measurement's alignment contribution. This paper proposes T-PCOT, a Transformer transfer method based on condition-supported partial optimal transport. Frequency, flux excursion, temperature, and waveform descriptors define a sparse graph of comparable operating conditions. A capacity-constrained transport plan distributes alignment across source measurements and leaves costly target mass unmatched. The plan is constructed from measured inputs before training and guides local waveform-feature consistency. An importance-weighted sampling scheme preserves both uniform source regression and the transport objective during minibatch optimization. Experiments on three material pairs and three target label budgets show that T-PCOT reduces mean relative error (MRE) and 95th-percentile error (P95) relative to Transformer-based multiple-kernel maximum mean discrepancy (T-MKMMD) in all nine comparisons. Macro MRE decreases from 12.60% to 9.65%, and macro P95 from 30.94% to 25.06%, corresponding to relative reductions of 23.41% and 19.01%. Controlled comparisons and ablations examine the roles of input processing, condition correspondence, and source capacity. The results demonstrate the predictive advantage of organizing cross-material alignment through operating-condition support over the compared global alignment method. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance in magnetic core loss transfer learning.

full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the E₈ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our E₈ k2v2 approach yields textasciitilde6× KV compression, roughly 20% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, E₈ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that E₈ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

full_list.title_en: CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.15603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.

full_list.title_en: Destructive Interference of a Charge Density Wave in the Skyrmion Magnet GdRu2Si2
full_list.title_zh: 斯格明子磁体 GdRu2Si2 中电荷密度波的相消干涉
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In skyrmion magnets, charge density waves induce higher-order exchange interactions that can select multi-Q ground states. Using resonant X-ray scattering and neutron diffraction, we measure temperature-dependent spin-charge coupling in GdRu2Si2. A minimal Landau model with one critical exponent and two ordering temperatures reproduces all six observed order parameters. Spin-density wave components of the multi-Q ground state drive charge ordering, but the onset of a magnetic helix suppresses it via destructive interference.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在斯格明子磁体中，电荷密度波诱发高阶交换相互作用，可以选择多 Q 基态。利用共振 X 射线散射和中子衍射，我们测量了 GdRu2Si2 中随温度变化的自旋电荷耦合。具有一个临界指数和两个有序温度的最小朗道模型可再现所有六个观察到的有序参数。多Q基态的自旋密度波分量驱动电荷排序，但磁螺旋的出现通过相消干涉抑制了它。

full_list.title_en: Real-space obstruction control of the shift current in two-dimensional Quantum Spin Hall insulators
full_list.title_zh: 二维量子自旋霍尔绝缘体中移位电流的实空间阻碍控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The search for materials exhibiting a large bulk photovoltaic effect has recently expanded to low-band-gap systems capable of operating in the infrared regime, with potential applications in optoelectronics. Among the microscopic mechanisms contributing to this phenomenon, the shift current is one of the dominant sources of photocurrent generation. Owing to its geometric origin, the shift current is not only determined by the optical transition probability but also by the real-space displacement associated with the optical excitation, making non-centrosymmetric materials with obstructed electronic wave functions particularly promising candidates. In this work, using a tight-binding model of a quantum spin Hall insulator on a triangular lattice, we investigate the nonlinear photocurrent across trivial, quantum spin Hall, and higher-order topological insulating phases. We show that obstructed topological phases exhibit a substantially enhanced shift-current response, despite the similar electronic band structure. We identify the origin of this enhancement in optical transitions between states belonging to distinct Wannier-center sectors, which allow for a large real-space displacement upon photoexcitation and, depending on the topological phase, control the sign of the shift current. Our results extend the search for controllable bulk photovoltaic effects to materials characterized by real-space electronic obstruction and identify indenene, a monolayer of In on SiC(0001), as a promising candidate for realizing this phenomenon.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对表现出大体积光伏效应的材料的研究最近已扩展到能够在红外区域工作的低带隙系统，并在光电子学中具有潜在的应用。在导致这种现象的微观机制中，移位电流是光电流产生的主要来源之一。由于其几何起源，位移电流不仅由光学跃迁概率决定，还由与光学激发相关的实空间位移决定，这使得具有受阻电子波函数的非中心对称材料特别有前途的候选材料。在这项工作中，我们使用三角晶格上量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的紧束缚模型，研究了平凡、量子自旋霍尔和高阶拓扑绝缘相之间的非线性光电流。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《二维量子自旋霍尔绝缘体中移位电流的实空间阻碍控制》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Superconductivity from altermagnetic fluctuations: the crucial role of sublattice polarization
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁涨落产生的超导：亚晶格极化的关键作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity in correlated systems often appears in the vicinity of a magnetically ordered state. This situation is also relevant for altermagnets, characterized by a nonrelativistic spin-split electronic structure in the presence of Néel order. Many proposed altermagnetic candidates, however, never cross the magnetic instability. We study superconductivity arising from altermagnetic fluctuations in such systems and show that the sublattice polarization (SLP) of the normal-state bands plays a pivotal role in determining the superconducting state. SLP, an inherent property of altermagnetic band structures that persists even without magnetic order, prevents Cooper pairs from forming between different sublattices. This suppresses pairing mediated by the nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic exchange, which favors spin-singlet superconductivity, and leaves longer-range same-sublattice bonds dominant. When the next-nearest-neighbor exchange is ferromagnetic, as expected for frustration-free Néel order, this results in spin-triplet superconductivity. This mechanism is fundamentally different from that in altermagnets with long-range Néel order, where the spin-split Fermi surfaces favor equal-spin pairing. Finally, when longer-range interactions in the disordered phase instead favor singlet pairing, SLP leads to singlet states with characteristic properties distinct from nearest-neighbor pairing states.
full_list.abstract_zh: 相关系统中的非常规超导性通常出现在磁有序态附近。这种情况也与交流磁体相关，其特征是存在尼尔阶的非相对论自旋分裂电子结构。然而，许多提出的变磁候选方案从未跨越磁不稳定性。我们研究了此类系统中交变磁涨落产生的超导性，并表明常态带的亚晶格极化（SLP）在确定超导状态中起着关键作用。 SLP 是交变磁带结构的一种固有特性，即使没有磁序，它也仍然存在，可防止不同亚晶格之间形成库珀对。这抑制了由最近邻反铁磁交换介导的配对，有利于自旋单线超导性，并使长程同亚晶格键占主导地位。

full_list.title_en: Bogoliubov excitations of a Bose-Einstein condensate in the presence of the non-Hermitian skin effect
full_list.title_zh: 存在非厄米集肤效应时玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的博戈柳博夫激发
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-Hermitian skin effect is one of the most remarkable topological features of non-conservative physics. It causes a macroscopic accumulation of states at the boundaries of a confined system, opening new ways for controlling and directing waves in non-Hermitian settings. This effect has recently been observed in experiments with Bose-Einstein condensates of exciton polaritons and ultracold bosonic quantum gases. The underlying physics is captured by a mean-field Hamiltonian with a trapping potential and an imaginary gauge field. While prior work has examined the effect of the imaginary gauge field term on the condensate itself, its effect on the collective excitations on top of the condensate remained unexplored. Here, we develop a new theory for the Bogoliubov excitations in a non-Hermitian framework and systematically study their spectrum across different interaction regimes. By analysing the position expectation values, we find that while the repulsive interactions oppose the localisation of the condensate due to the skin effect, the excitations remain strongly affected by the imaginary gauge field. As a consequence, in the presence of harmonic confinement, we predict a strong shift in the dipole oscillation frequency, which can be observed in experiments. This is in contrast to Hermitian systems, where this frequency is fixed by the trap dimensions. Furthermore, we develop a consistent second-quantised field theory of the collective excitations in this non-Hermitian system. Strikingly, we find that a second-quantised treatment removes the shift of the dipole oscillation frequency entirely. This intriguing discrepancy between the two theoretical approaches to the treatment of elementary excitations in a non-Hermitian system can be resolved in experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 非厄米集肤效应是非保守物理学最显着的拓扑特征之一。它导致受限系统边界处的宏观状态积累，为非厄米环境中控制和引导波开辟了新的方法。最近在激子极化激元的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体和超冷玻色子量子气体的实验中观察到了这种效应。底层物理由具有俘获势和虚规范场的平均场哈密顿量捕获。虽然之前的工作已经研究了虚规范场项对凝聚体本身的影响，但它对凝聚体顶部集体激励的影响仍未被探索。在这里，我们在非厄米框架中开发了一种关于博戈柳博夫激发的新理论，并系统地研究了它们在不同相互作用机制中的光谱。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米集肤效应是非保守物理学最显着的拓扑特征之一。它导致受限系统边界处的宏观状态积累，为非厄米环境中控制和引导波开辟了新的方法。最近在激子极化激元的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体和超冷玻色子量子气体的实验中观察到了这种效应。底层物理由具有俘获势和虚规范场的平均场哈密顿量捕获。虽然之前的工作已经研究了虚规范场项对凝聚体本身的影响，但它对凝聚体顶部集体激励的影响仍未被探索。在这里，我们在非厄米框架中开发了一种关于博戈柳博夫激发的新理论，并系统地研究了它们在不同相互作用机制中的光谱。通过分析位置期望值，我们发现，虽然由于趋肤效应，排斥相互作用反对凝聚态的局域化，但激励仍然受到虚规范场的强烈影响。因此，在存在谐波限制的情况下，我们预测偶极子振荡频率会发生强烈变化，这可以在实验中观察到。这与埃尔米特系统相反，埃尔米特系统的频率由陷阱尺寸决定。此外，我们在这个非厄米系统中开发了一致的集体激发的第二量子化场论。引人注目的是，我们发现第二次量子化处理完全消除了偶极子振荡频率的偏移。在非厄米系统中处理基本激励的两种理论方法之间的这种有趣的差异可以通过实验来解决。

full_list.title_en: Composition-controlled optical fingerprints and anisotropy of self-trapped excitons in double perovskites
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Composition-controlled optical fingerprints and anisotropy of self-trapped excitons in double perovskites
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.18665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Double perovskites (DPs) offer a compositionally versatile platform for photocatalysis and optoelectronics, but their soft lattices favor strong exciton-phonon coupling and self-trapped excitons (STEs), which produce broad, red-shifted photoluminescence (PL). Here, we combine optical spectroscopy and ab initio calculations to study lead-free, Sb-doped Cs2BInCl6 nanocrystals with B-site alloying from Na to K. Alloying tunes the PL energy from about 2.48 to 2.70 eV, while absorption features near 3.8 eV remain nearly unchanged. Calculations reveal that Sb doping enables bright radiative recombination channels and delocalizes the excitonic wavefunction. We identify STEs responsible for the large PL red shift, associated with an upward shift of dopant-hybridized in-gap states. Na-to-K substitution selectively changes the STE lattice distortion, explaining why PL varies strongly with composition while absorption does not. Theory further predicts pronounced PL polarization anisotropy that reflects the STE wavefunction's spatial structure and depends on B-site composition. Time-resolved anisotropy measurements closely agree with these predictions, providing experimental fingerprints of the excitonic wavefunction and its evolution with alloying. Together, these results disentangle the roles of doping and alloying in lead-free DPs and establish polarization-resolved spectroscopy as a probe of STE wavefunctions.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.16061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the electronic structure of a delafossite oxide CuAlO₂ in comparison with CuCrO₂, using vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) and hard x-ray (HX) photoemission spectroscopy (PES) and band structure calculations within the local-density approximation +U scheme. Cu 3p! -! 3d resonant PES and Cu 2p core-level HX-PES give concrete evidence that the Cu valence in CuAlO₂ is monovalent, which makes a sharp contrast to CuCrO₂ that showed contradictory results depending upon probing methods [Yokobori et al., Phys. Rev. B 87, 195124 (2013)]. We further noticed weak but detectable satellite structures due to Cu²⁺ state in the Cu 2p HX-PES spectrum of CuCrO₂, surprisingly, without an observable main peak due to the Cu²⁺ state. Comparisons between the valence-band HX-PES spectra and the band structure calculations revealed a significant amount of the Cu 4s and Al 3s/Cr 4s states in the valence band. The above results can reasonably be explained by the Cu 3d, 4s-Cr 3d charge transfer model that we previously proposed in the above paper, thereby demonstrating the critical role of empty 3d orbitals in the electronic structure of the copper delafossite oxides.

full_list.title_en: EpNet-Si: Atomic Form Factors Learned from Band Structures
full_list.title_zh: EpNet-Si：从能带结构中了解原子形状因素
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.14992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The empirical pseudopotential method (EPM) computes band structures with one diagonalization per k point and no self-consistency, but its fixed atomic form factors do not transfer between crystal structures. To address this limitation, we introduce EpNet-Si, an EPM for silicon in which an equivariant network predicts each atom's plane-wave form factor from its local environment: a species potential plus monopole, dipole and quadrupole corrections, mixed by a learned router over atomic densities, together with an s/p nonlocal projector. With 6,195 parameters, the model is trained through the eigensolver on reference density functional theory (DFT) band energies of only 77 cells. Among 231 distortions of the trained structure types, the 142 gapped cells have mean band and gap errors of 15 and 8,meV; among 192 unseen structures, the 165 gapped cells have mean errors of 38 and 49,meV. Physical properties derived from EpNet-Si, including effective masses, gap pressure coefficients, deformation potentials and the density of states at the Fermi level, agree with those obtained from the reference DFT calculations. These results suggest that the classical EPM, fitted to a small set of reference data, can be extended into a fast alternative for modern electronic band-structure calculations.
